explication: This repository implements the Terraform Google Cloud provider: Terraform configuration is handled by the provider, which registers resource and data-source schemas and manages Google Cloud resources through service-specific implementations and shared transport. The README documents the provider’s purpose; source-index references and excerpts support the registration and shared-runtime relationships shown. Several service implementations were not sampled, so their individual API-call details are not expanded.
